definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Orbital Data Relay Rings.

Signature ring hulls program, charter one: master relay sats at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale ring logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate handoff protocols systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Orbital Data Relay Rings becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: Readiness Estimator: Orbital Data Relay Rings

description:
The estimator scores the six Orbital Data Relay Rings components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a ring hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

t: Orbital Data Relay Rings Systems Simulator
title: Orbital Data Relay Rings Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Orbital Data Relay Rings operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Orbital Data Relay Rings installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 64381 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where relay sats monitoring, ring logistics redundancy, or handoff protocols maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

t: Orbital Data Relay Rings Master Roadmap
title: Orbital Data Relay Rings Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Orbital Data Relay Rings: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Orbital Data Relay Rings — rings of relays around the planet.

Phase 1 — Prove (relay sats): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (ring logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (handoff protocols): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (ground stations): ring hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and orbit-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
